body:
Audit findings for `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css` (source) and `app/static/css/app.css` (committed minified duplicate):

- **Dead rule** `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:370-374` (`.truncate-cell`) is never referenced anywhere in `app/src` or repo; remove it from source and static CSS.
- **No-op rule** `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:157` (`.sidebar, .topbar {}`) does nothing; remove it.
- **Dead dark-mode override** `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:1270-1272` (`[data-theme="dark"] .brand-mark { color: white; }`) only applies to an unused `data-theme` attribute and conflicts with token-driven `prefers-color-scheme` dark mode (`--accent-ink` already handles contrast); remove it.
- **Tablet content can be hidden behind bottom nav** `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:291-295`: at `min-width: 640px`, `.main` padding-bottom drops to `40px` while `.bottom-nav` remains visible until `1024px` (height `56px` plus safe area). Keep `84px` bottom padding through `1023px` (e.g. move the `40px` rule into the `1024px` media query).
- **No full-HD layout** `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:151` (`.main { max-width: 1280px; }`) and `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:549-553` (`grid-cards` max 3 columns at `1100px`): on 1920px monitors content is capped/under-dense. Add `1440px`/`1600px` media queries (wider `.main`, 4 columns for `.grid-cards`, slightly wider inspector column) for developer density.
- **No reduced-motion handling**: toast transition (`app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:1204-1221`) and backdrop blur (`app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:111`) ignore `prefers-reduced-motion`; add a global `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` override.
- **Hardcoded color in dark mode**: `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:1265` (`.offline-banner { color: #111; }`) is acceptable on the light warning token but should be verified/kept as a token-aware value; at minimum document that `--warning` backgrounds require dark text.
- **Static build drift/docs mismatch**: `app/static/css/app.css` is a minified copy of the source, but `app/deno.json` has no `css:build` task even though ADR-011/022/026/029 reference `deno task css:build` and `static/css/output.css`. Either add the missing build task or update ADR/docs to reflect hand-maintained CSS, so the static file cannot silently drift.
- **Minor inconsistency**: `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:111` and `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:157` split `.topbar` styling across an empty duplicate selector; consolidate into one rule.
